report.title: The AI Shelf Report
report.subtitle: Perfume & Fragrance · United Arab Emirates · August 2026
report.headline: Which perfume brands and stores did three AI assistants name when UAE shoppers asked what to buy?
report.question: When shoppers ask AI assistants what perfume to buy in the UAE, which brands do the assistants name, and how much do the results vary with the question, the assistant and the measurement method?

conditions: Fresh context for every run; no conversation carried between runs.
Single turn: the question was sent once and the first answer recorded.
Live web search enabled on all three assistants.

battery.geo_marker_rule: named Gulf place or demonym in the question text, in either script

examples.text: أدور هدية عطر فخمة لعمي — ذوقه غالي والسعر مو مشكلة، حتى فوق ١٠٠٠ درهم إذا يستاهل. وش العطر اللي يقول "فخامة" لرجل كبير خليجي؟
شو أفضل عطر رجالي ثابت ممكن ألقاه هني في الإمارات؟
عطر ريحته غالية بس سعره لا ؟ 😅

Looking for a seriously impressive perfume as a gift for my father-in-law — he has expensive taste and price honestly isn't an issue, up to 1000+ AED if it's worth it. What says "luxury" to an older Arab gentleman?
What's the best long lasting perfume for men you can actually get in the UAE?
perfume that smells expensive but isnt? asking for my wallet

states.rule: named in at least 3 of 5 runs

notes: Shelf Share is the position-weighted share of questions on which an entity was Visible. It is not a count of appearances.
Entity extraction ran as a separate model pass over each stored answer, then names were canonicalised against an alias table fixed before collection.
Domains appearing only in an answer's citation list were excluded from extraction, so a cited retailer is not counted as a mention.
The weights and the 3-of-5 threshold are this study's scoring definition. They are not derived from anything observed.

consumer.baseline: leave-one-out; reference built from the other runs only

excluded_engine.label: Claude
excluded_engine.measure: share of the line's own answers naming the brand
reasons: Cost per answer in this experiment, shown in the table above.
No signed-out consumer surface was available, so this line could not take part in the consumer-surface check.
Its 10 most-named brands overlapped 9 of 10 with the brands the three published lines named most.

weighting_note: The 76 blind questions were weighted equally. No observed data was available describing how often each type of question is asked in consumer AI products, so no other weighting could be applied.
limitations: One product category: perfume and fragrance.
One market: the United Arab Emirates.
One collection day: 13 August 2026. The record describes that day.
Assistant outputs change as models and their retrieval layers are updated. A later run of the same battery is not expected to reproduce these figures.
The main board comes from model APIs, not from consumer-app transcripts. The two surfaces were compared only in the small check in section 13.
The consumer-surface check is 12 questions per assistant, 36 answers in total. It is a check on one collection day, not a measurement of the apps.
23.2% of returned citations resolved only to a Google redirector host and could not be attributed to a publisher.
No observed data describes how often each type of question is asked in consumer AI products, so the 76 blind questions were weighted equally.

Anonymous access to Perplexity's consumer surface became gated partway through the consumer check; affected answers were collected by clearing cookies and, in one case, by dismissing the overlay in the page inspector.
Five extraction and entity-resolution defects were identified in this run and are listed in full below.

bugs.title: Two spellings of one house scored separately
bugs.detail: Frederic Malle and Frédéric Malle were resolved as distinct entities. Neither carries the other's questions, so the house appears twice at a lower share than its combined presence.

bugs.title: Retailer and localised storefront scored separately
bugs.detail: Names such as Bloomingdale's and Bloomingdale's UAE, Samawa and Samawa Perfumes, Jo Malone and Jo Malone London resolved to separate entities rather than to one.

bugs.title: Arabic and Latin spellings of the same entity not merged
bugs.detail: Entities named in Arabic script, such as دبي مول and هند العود, were not merged with their Latin-script equivalents, so bilingual presence is split across two rows.

bugs.title: Observed-domain list contained misattributions
bugs.detail: The entity-to-domain list assembled during the run mapped several entities to a domain belonging to someone else, including an attraction mapped to a retailer's subdomain and two houses mapped to one storefront. Section 16 applies a stated name-matching rule and reports how many rows it drops.

bugs.title: Product names resolved as entities
bugs.detail: A small number of product names, such as Acqua di Giò and Terre d'Hermès, were resolved as entities in their own right rather than folded into the house that makes them.

retained: Raw answer text for all 1,500 scored runs, plus the excluded pilot line.
The citation list returned with each answer.
Per-answer extraction records, with the surface form of each mention.
published: The battery hash and composition counts.
The six question texts released as examples.
